name: Cognitive Load Regulation Circuit
short_description: Monitors working memory load against task demands and environmental distraction to regulate attention allocation and prevent cognitive overload.

components.name: WM_LOAD_MONITOR
components.description: Tracks active working memory load and capacity utilization

components.name: DEMAND_ESTIMATOR
components.description: Estimates cognitive demands of current task

components.name: DISTRACTION_DETECTOR
components.description: Quantifies environmental and internal sources of attention capture

components.name: ALLOCATION_CONTROLLER
components.description: Adjusts attention allocation and task-switching to match WM capacity

key_references: Sweller, J. (1988). Cognitive load during problem solving: Effects on learning. Cognitive Science, 12(2), 257–285.
Lavie, N. (2005). Distracted and confused?: Selective attention under load. Trends in Cognitive Sciences, 9(2), 75–82.
design_implications: Reduce extraneous cognitive load in high-demand tasks; minimize visual clutter, simplify navigation, and eliminate unnecessary information from task environments
Design for variable load: provide information chunking and progressive disclosure for complex tasks; allow breaks and context-switching points to restore WM capacity
